name: io.github.PugarHuda/gatekeeper
title: Gatekeeper
description: Mandate gate for agent spending: actions and x402 payments judged by the enclave contract's logic.

environmentVariables.name: T3N_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tenant API key. Needed only by gate_execute (the enclave path); every read-only tool works without it.

environmentVariables.name: DID
environmentVariables.description: Tenant DID the gate contract is registered under (with T3N_API_KEY).

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM key that signs x402 payments in fetch_paid_resource. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: X402_FACILITATOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: x402 facilitator used for verify/settle. Defaults to the public one.
